description:
Design closed. PipeWire capture backend boundary for the v2 native/helper replay engine is locked. Linux/Wayland first, xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast + PipeWire only, X11 and non-portal Wayland skipped.

Five layers: Electron UI -> IPC contract (T-008) -> helper capture orchestrator -> CaptureSource trait -> portal session + pw_stream. Frames cross from the trait into the encoder inside the helper; they never cross IPC. Electron never sees a frame.

Electron-facing capture methods (final names locked in T-008): requestSession, startStream, pauseStream/resumeStream, stopSession, setRegion, setFramerateHint, setCursorMode. Helper -> Electron events: sessionReady (explicit, replaces v1.1.0 timer-based guess), formatChanged, streamPaused/streamResumed, sessionLost (typed reason code), diagnostics.

Helper owns: D-Bus portal connection, PipeWire core/loop, all pw_stream objects, SPA param negotiation, DMA-BUF vs SHM negotiation, modifier list intersection with encoder-import support, restore-token persistence under $XDG_STATE_HOME, in-process frame channel to encoder, failure classification, diagnostics emission, on-failure diagnostic dump.

CaptureSource trait surface: caps(), current_format(), frames() async FrameHandle stream (PTS, fourcc, modifier, DmaBuf | Shm payload, optional cursor metadata, ReleaseToken for buffer return), pause()/resume()/stop(). Encoder backends (T-005) consume this trait only; no PipeWire types leak past it. Trait is shaped so WgcSource and ScreenCaptureKitSource slot in without reshape.

Capture modes for v2.0.0: monitor, window, region. Region is composed (monitor capture + encoder-boundary crop), absorbing Issue #1 without portal cooperation. setRegion mid-stream does not re-prompt. Virtual sources, multi-stream replay, X11, and non-portal Wayland are deferred.

Buffer negotiation: DMA-BUF preferred (with modifier list intersected against encoder import); linear DMA-BUF fallback before SHM; SHM accepted as last resort; failure to find any acceptable mode is a hard sessionLost(no-acceptable-buffer-type), not a silent slow path. Format preference: NV12 > P010 (encoder-gated) > RGB (encoder-side convert). No capture-layer scaling or letterboxing. Source-native resolution accepted as-is.

Framerate hints are advisory only. Capture layer never synthesizes duplicate frames (fixes v1.1.0 fake-60fps). Encoder backend decides constant-fps vs VFR.

Cursor modes map to portal Hidden | Embedded | Metadata. Default embedded for v2.0.0; metadata preferred long-term, gated on compositor support with transparent downgrade.

Dynamic resolution changes (drag between monitors, resize captured window, monitor mode change): OnParamChanged triggers buffer re-negotiation, emits formatChanged, surfaces new caps through the trait. Encoder/segment layer absorbs the discontinuity. Capture layer never hides a format change.

Failure reason codes: portal-denied, portal-restore-rejected, portal-unavailable, pipewire-disconnected (bounded reconnect), pipewire-state-error, source-removed, no-acceptable-buffer-type, format-renegotiation-failed, compositor-paused (soft, not a session loss), encoder-disconnected. Every sessionLost carries a structured details blob (compositor, PipeWire version, last format, last cursor mode). On sessionLost the last 60 s of diagnostics is written to $XDG_STATE_HOME/cove-screen-recorder/diagnostics/<sessionId>.json.

Diagnostics invariant: capture-layer reports buffers negotiated, in flight, dropped since last tick, total produced; observed cadence vs hinted framerate; compositor name; PipeWire core version; last negotiation latency. Combined with T-005 encoder counters and T-006 segment-buffer counters, a user can prove whether a dropped frame happened at capture, encode, or segment write without re-running. v1.1.0 cannot distinguish these layers; v2 must.

Issue absorption confirmed: Issue #1 (crop unclear) -> first-class region mode + setRegion. Issue #3 (source does not record until hovered) -> eliminated by removing the DOM/canvas hover dependency entirely; T-004 validation matrix includes a 60 s minimized-preview test that must produce the expected frame count.

Test/validation cases enumerated in N-003 section 17 (selection-phase, per-mode capture, lifecycle, cursor, region, hover-regression, diagnostics). These feed T-009.

Deferred: audio capture boundary, virtual sources, multi-stream replay, X11 capture, Wayland-without-portal, end-to-end HDR pipeline, restore-token encryption, Windows DXGI/WGC implementation, macOS ScreenCaptureKit implementation.

Output: .story/notes/N-003.json (full design + diagram-in-text + validation cases). .story/project-state.md updated with the boundary summary. No code, no package changes, no Electron / renderer / recorder / build / CI / test changes.

Next downstream tickets that may proceed: T-005 (encoder matrix - can start in parallel; the trait surface here is the only contract it needs), T-006 (rolling segment buffer - depends on T-005), T-007 (export/remux - depends on T-005, T-006), T-008 (Electron <-> helper IPC - depends on this ticket).
title: Design PipeWire capture backend boundary
